concept.concept: Block-print style illustration of heirloom vegetables and herbs arranged in a grid with text 'Local First, Always' in stamp lettering
concept.audience: Farmers market shoppers, locavore food culture followers, and sustainable living advocates
concept.rationale: Tote bags are functionally used at farmers markets making the niche-format match excellent; late summer harvest season peaks August-September aligning with the buying window; block-print aesthetic appeals to the artisan sensibility of this audience

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Local First, Always" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector block-print illustration of heirloom vegetables and herbs arranged in a 3×3 grid: tomato, carrot, basil leaf, beet, lettuce, thyme sprig, pepper, kale, and radish. Each item is a bold simple silhouette with clean sharp edges, solid color blocks, no gradients or shading. Color palette: deep forest green, burnt orange, deep red, cream, and charcoal. Single centered composition on a plain cream background with generous margin. High contrast, screen-print aesthetic, readable from across a room. Text 'Local First, Always' in bold stamp-style serif lettering arched across the bottom of the grid. No photorealism, no busy backgrounds, no drop shadows.
design.style: Flat vector block-print, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic, solid color blocks only, high contrast, stamp lettering

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Local First, Always' is a generic sentiment promoting local sourcing with no known trademark associations. Block-print heirloom vegetable illustrations are a common folk-art style with no IP concerns. The overall concept uses generic farming and locavore themes without referencing any brand, character, celebrity, or protected slogan.

image_verdict.reason: The text 'LOCAL FIRST, ALWAYS' is correctly spelled and complete, matching the required phrase. The design features clean, generic vegetable illustrations (tomato, carrot, beet, lettuce, basil, herbs, pepper, kale) in a flat graphic style with no IP concerns, no anatomical elements, and a clean cream background suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Local First Farmers Market Heirloom Vegetables Block Print Tote
listing.description: Make a statement about your food values with this block-print style tote celebrating local, seasonal eating. Heirloom vegetables and herbs arranged in a beautiful grid with 'Local First, Always' in authentic stamp lettering. Perfect for weekly farmers market runs, supporting local agriculture, and sustainable food shopping. A durable, reusable bag that shows your commitment to locavore living and community food systems.
